creator: Dan McCreary

description: A sinusoid of N samples is multiplied by a rectangular, Hamming, Hanning, Blackman or Kaiser window and transformed. The spectrum shows the DFT bins on top of the underlying DTFT, with the main-lobe width, peak side-lobe level, scalloping loss and coherent gain measured from the window's own transform.

educational.topic: Spectral leakage and the resolution versus side-lobe trade-off of window functions
learningObjectives: Explain spectral leakage as a consequence of observing a signal for a finite time
Predict whether a tone will leak from its frequency and the bin spacing
Compare windows by main-lobe width, peak side-lobe level and scalloping loss
Choose a window for resolving two close tones or for finding a weak tone near a strong one
prerequisites: Multiplication in time as convolution in frequency

equations: X[k] = sum over n of x[n] w[n] e^(-j 2 pi k n / N), bin spacing = fs / N
Hanning: w[n] = 0.5 - 0.5 cos(2 pi n / N); Hamming: w[n] = 0.54 - 0.46 cos(2 pi n / N)
Blackman: w[n] = 0.42 - 0.5 cos(2 pi n / N) + 0.08 cos(4 pi n / N)
assumptions: fs = 1024 Hz; the second close tone is 6 Hz above the first; the weak tone is 24 Hz above and 40 dB below the strong one
The DTFT curve is an 8x zero-padded FFT of the windowed signal
Window properties are measured on a 512-point window zero-padded 64 times
The signal is a real sinusoid, so leakage from its negative-frequency image is included

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict whether a tone will leak, test it, then compare windows on measured properties
keyQuestions: Why does a tone that is not on a bin centre spread into every bin?
What do you gain and what do you lose by choosing a window with lower side lobes?
What does a longer FFT improve, and what does it leave unchanged?
commonMisconceptions: Leakage is a numerical error of the FFT
A tapered window always gives a better spectrum than the rectangular window
Zero-padding or a longer FFT lowers the side lobes of a window
assessmentOpportunities: Tabulate main-lobe width and peak side-lobe level for the four fixed windows
Decide which windows reveal a tone 40 dB below a strong neighbour
